hero.tagline: In the quiet between thoughts, the universe whispers its eternal song

today.heading: The moment holds all moments — past, present, future unfold
today.intro: There is a sacredness in the ordinary — a teacup warming your hands, sunlight catching dust in the air, the quiet rhythm of breath. These are not mere distractions from the spiritual path; they are the path itself. When we wash dishes with full attention, when we listen to rain without trying to name it, when we feel the exact texture of our clothing against our skin — we are practicing presence. The moment is not a stepping stone to something better; it is the destination, the home, the complete expression of what it means to be alive. In this very now, all seeking ends and all finding begins.

visualAsset.description: Impressionist lunar aurora — a luminous full moon rendered in soft silver and pale gold, surrounded by sweeping curtains of aurora borealis in translucent blues, violets, and seafoam greens, with impressionist brushstroke textures and scattered starlight

moon.label: II. The Beginner's Mind
moon.heading: To see clearly, first admit you do not know
moon.intro: The Moon never apologizes for her phases. She does not hide her dark side or rush to be full again. In her patient cycle, she teaches what the ego cannot grasp: that diminishment is not failure, that darkness is not the enemy of light but its necessary partner. The tide rises and falls. The lily opens and closes. The heart contracts and expands. To be alive is to move through phases — and to trust that the fullness will return, not because we demand it, but because it is the nature of things to turn.

philosophy.label: I. The Living Question
philosophy.heading: The question is more alive than the answer
philosophy.intro: Stand at the edge of the sea and watch the waves arrive. Each one believes itself unique — this particular crest, this specific crash of foam. And yet the ocean makes no distinction between its waves. It sends them all to shore with equal generosity, watches them dissolve without grief. What if the self is not a fortress to be defended but a wave to be surfed — a temporary form through which the vastness of being experiences the joy of reaching land?

gita.label: IV. The Free Action
gita.heading: Action without attachment is freedom in motion
gita.intro: Krishna did not ask Arjuna to stop feeling. He did not demand courage or demand certainty. He asked only this: do the work that is yours to do, and release your grip on what comes after. This is not detachment as coldness — it is detachment as the deepest form of trust. The tulip does not worry about whether its bloom will be admired. It opens because opening is its nature. The warrior fights because the fight is dharma. The rest is not his to carry.

shiva.label: V. The Endless Return
shiva.heading: In the ending, the beginning whispers its name
shiva.intro: Listen closely to any rhythm and you will find the secret: it is not the beats that make the music, but the silence between them. Shiva's damaru strikes, and from that vibration, all language, all melody, all creation pours forth. But the drum is nothing without the pause. The dancer is nothing without the breath between movements. To find the sacred, do not look for the spectacular — listen for the silence that holds the spectacular in place.

art.label: III. The Unseen Bloom
art.heading: Beauty appears when you stop looking for it
art.intro: Why do we make art? Not to decorate walls or fill silence, but because there are experiences so large they cannot be contained in the body — they must be externalized, given form, released into the world. A painting is a soul's overflow. A melody is the heart's excess. The artist does not create from abundance but from the desperate need to share what is too vast for one person to carry alone. Every brushstroke is an act of generosity: I felt this, and I am giving it to you.
